name: Save Techbot's Brain!
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Gives 4,750 experience instead of 2,650, 1.79 times as much. Read from what the game server sent in the beta. Its experience counts the level 30 build, which halved what dungeon quests give beyond a normal quest.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
When our beloved city Gnomeregan fell, a rogue spark must have jolted my poor creation, Techbot.  It once aided me and my associates with its countless gizmos and limitless store of information, but its positronic brain has polarized.  Now it's negatronic... and Techbot's behaviors are reversed.  It roams Gnomeregan in a frenzy!

But perhaps it can be salvaged.  Perhaps, if you can retrieve Techbot's memory core and bring it to me, I can discover the cause of the polarization and fix my poor Techbot.
narrative.objectives: Bring Techbot's Memory Core to Tinkmaster Overspark in Ironforge.
narrative.offerRewardText: Oh, this is wonderful!  Thank you, adventurer!  I'll get to work immediately!!Poor, poor Techbot... Don't feel bad.  We'll get you fixed.Now, where did I put that plug for my hydro-jack swivel spanner...
narrative.requestItemsText: Did you find Techbot?  Did you retrieve its memory core??
